title: International Prognostic score pour Asymptomatic Early-stage CLL (IPS-E)
abbreviations: International Prognostic Score for asymptomatic early-stage CLL (IPS-E)
formula:
The IPS-E is calculated by adding the selected points for each variable:

| Variable | Points | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Unmutated IGHV genes | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Absolute lymphocyte count >15×10 9 /L | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Palpable lymph nodes | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |

how_to_use.why:
- Fournit une mesure quantitative permettant de stratifier les patients atteints de CLL de stade précoce en fonction du risque de progression de la maladie et du besoin potentiel de traitement.
- Peut aider à adapter les plans de surveillance et de traitement selon le risque individuel, ce qui peut améliorer les résultats cliniques des patients.
- Utile pour discuter du pronostic avec les patients et fixer les attentes concernant l’évolution de leur maladie.
how_to_use.when: À utiliser chez les patients ayant un diagnostic de leucémie lymphoïde chronique (CLL) de stade précoce (stades 0-II de [Rai](nabda:calc.rai-staging-system-chronic-lymphocytic-leukemia-cll) ou stade A de [Binet](nabda:calc.binet
how_to_use.pearls:
- Specifically designed for early-stage CLL; not applicable for advanced disease stages.
- Utility may be limited if immunoglobulin heavy chain variable region (IGHV) gene mutation status is not available at the time of diagnosis.

next_steps.advice:
- Patients with low scores may be suitable for regular monitoring without immediate treatment, reinforcing the "watch and wait" approach.
- Higher scores indicate a greater risk of disease progression and may suggest a need for more frequent monitoring or consideration of early therapeutic interventions, including novel agents and potential enrollment in clinical trials.
- As CLL can evolve, it is important to periodically re-evaluate the patient’s status and adjust management plans accordingly.
- Consider the score as part of a holistic assessment that includes other prognostic markers and patient factors to guide therapy selection.

more_info:
Interprétation :

| IPS-E | Risque de nécessité de traitement |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | Faible |
| 1 | Intermédiaire |
| 2-3 | Élevé |

medium_description: Évalue le pronostic de la leucémie lymphoïde chronique (CLL) asymptomatique de stade précoce.
